account_policy.breach: equity strictly below floor; permanent failure; challenge liquidation after observed breach; no reset
account_policy.target: naturally flat only before OnTester; no target liquidation
account_policy.phase2: Fresh $10k from next Prague calendar day, model handover assumption, only if Phase1 passed
account_policy.margin: No resize; reject new entry when gross open + pending + proposed USD notional / 15 exceeds current equity. No additional percent buffer.

limitations: Static source and settings audit; native output accounting/parity is checked separately after execution.
Primary-symbol ticks plus one-second secondary latest-quote sampling do not certify every historical floating-equity excursion.
Gross notional/15 margin is an explicit conservative research proxy, not a certified FTMO contract model.
